categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in military electronic component reliability testing services and environmental reliability testing services for military equipment and subsystems. Its services include electronic component testing and reliability screening, destructive physical analysis (DPA), failure analysis, and reliability management technical support. It also engages in electronic component R&D, design, packaging, testing, and software development.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include integrated circuit reliability testing, discrete device reliability testing, microwave device reliability testing, component reliability testing, DPA technology, and environmental reliability testing. The company has developed advanced testing capabilities such as DDR3 dynamic random access memory testing, high-speed and high-precision AD/DA testing, microwave device full-parameter automatic testing, and high-voltage aging testing up to 6000V. It also employs intelligent evaluation technologies for environmental reliability tests and has a comprehensive R&D system for test programs and adapters.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are military industrial group subsidiaries and electronic component suppliers supporting military enterprises. Major military groups served include China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation, China Aerospace Science and Industry Corporation, China Aviation Industry Corporation, China Aviation Engine Group, China Shipbuilding Industry Corporation, China Ordnance Industry Group, and others. The end markets are military electronic systems used in airborne, vehicle-mounted, shipborne, missile-borne, and artillery-borne applications across aerospace, aviation, shipbuilding, ordnance, and electronics sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with key reliability testing service bases in Chengdu (Southwest), Xi'an (Northwest), and Wuxi (East China). It also has a presence in Hainan (South China) through a newly established subsidiary. Its market coverage extends to major military industrial regions including Southwest, Northwest, East China, North China, Central China, South China, and Northeast China.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates as an independent third-party service provider in the midstream segment of the military electronic components supply chain, focusing on reliability testing, screening, and analysis services for electronic components and military equipment subsystems.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding testing capabilities, especially in environmental reliability, electromagnetic compatibility, and low-earth orbit commercial satellite sectors. The company emphasizes R&D in high-end integrated circuit testing, intelligent detection technologies, and automated testing platforms. It invests in developing new test programs, adapters, and testing processes, and fosters talent acquisition and collaboration with research institutes to maintain technological leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through service fees from reliability testing and screening of electronic components, destructive physical analysis, failure analysis, and technical support services. The company uses a direct sales model, engaging directly with military industrial customers and component manufacturers, with pricing negotiated based on component type, test complexity, and market competition.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the leading independent third-party military electronic component reliability testing providers in China, competing with military group-affiliated testing institutions and other private testing firms such as Xi'an Xigu and Jinghanyu. It holds a strong market position due to its broad testing capabilities, extensive certifications, and recognized service quality, especially in the military sector.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 195 million, a 19.69% decrease from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 43 million, down 55.75%. Total assets reached RMB 1.84 billion, growing 6.24% year-over-year. The company increased R&D investment by 4.53% to RMB 22.3 million, representing 11.43% of revenue. Despite revenue decline due to military industry adjustments, cash flow from operations improved significantly by 143.65%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes advanced and comprehensive reliability testing technologies with a wide range of testing parameters and certifications (CNAS, DILAC). It offers integrated one-stop services with strong R&D capabilities, including proprietary test programs and adapters. Its geographic presence in key military industrial regions enables rapid response and cost-effective service. The company’s strong reputation and broad customer base in the military sector provide a competitive advantage in a market with high technical and qualification barriers.
